parsed.note_claim: George Soros is not under house arrest, no federal raid occurred on his estate, and his son did not flee to Dubai.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Soros has not been placed under house arrest. No credible outlet has reported federal agents at his property. Alexander Soros fleeing on a pre-dawn flight to Dubai, that specific detail, with that specific timestamp, comes from nowhere verifiable.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states that claims regarding house arrest, federal agents at the property, and the son fleeing are false or unverified.
